say:1:1730158301:1.text: Isn't it obvious? They're on terrible terms.
say:1:1730158301:1.source_cn: 这还用问？那当然是……糟透了。
say:1:1730158301:1.male: Isn't it obvious? They're on terrible terms.
say:1:1730158301:1.female: Isn't it obvious? They're on terrible terms.

say:2:1730158302:1.text: Prince Orion, a warrior himself, has been pushing for war against the Bantus.
say:2:1730158302:1.source_cn: 我们的奥利安王子勇武无双，一直主张对班题斯用兵。
say:2:1730158302:1.male: Prince Orion, a warrior himself, has been pushing for war against the Bantus.
say:2:1730158302:1.female: Prince Orion, a warrior himself, has been pushing for war against the Bantus.

say:3:1730158303:1.text: Meanwhile, the Queen insists on peace talks... I don't see the point.
say:3:1730158303:1.source_cn: 而摄政的王后却只敢和谈……真不知道有什么好谈的。
say:3:1730158303:1.male: Meanwhile, the Queen insists on peace talks... I don't see the point.
say:3:1730158303:1.female: Meanwhile, the Queen insists on peace talks... I don't see the point.
